body.condition: For every substantive variable \(V_i\) and every pair \((J,K)\) in either family specified in Yang et al.'s Assumption 3—either \(J\subseteq\operatorname{An}_M(V_i)\) and \(K\subseteq\operatorname{PP}_M(V_i)\), or \(V_i\) is an mleaf with parent \(V_j\), \(J\subseteq\operatorname{An}_M(V_i)\setminus\{V_j\}\), and \(K\subseteq\operatorname{PP}_M(V_j)\)—the rank of \(W^J_{K\cup\{V_i\}}\) equals the minimum cardinality of a vertex bottleneck from \(J\) to \(K\cup\{V_i\}\), allowing endpoints in the bottleneck.
